title: CYBER-14 Independent External Reviewer Sign-Off Template
description: Template for independent human security review and sign-off for CYBER-14 AC-3 verification.

checklist_descriptions.dataset_provenance_verified: Verified that frozen CIC-DDoS2019 test sample and metadata hashes match SHA256SUMS.txt.
checklist_descriptions.feature_contract_78_verified: Verified that all 78 network flow features match the standard feature specification without schema drift.
checklist_descriptions.o2_binary_accuracy_verified: Verified that O2 XGBoost binary model achieves >= 99.0% accuracy and <= 1.0% FPR against frozen test partition.
checklist_descriptions.o3_multiclass_inventory_verified: Verified that O3 Random Forest 8-class model achieves >= 95.0% multiclass accuracy across all 7 attack classes.
checklist_descriptions.flash_crowd_non_destructive_verified: Verified that flash-crowd benign surge traffic does not trigger blackhole or rate-limit mitigation (0% destructive FPR).
checklist_descriptions.latency_p95_bounded_verified: Verified that inference pipeline latency P95 <= 30.0 ms (P50 ~19.2 ms, P95 ~22.6 ms in isolated runs).
checklist_descriptions.resource_envelope_memory_ceiling_verifie: Verified that backend process memory RSS <= 512 MB and model footprint <= 50 MB.
checklist_descriptions.degraded_mode_fail_closed_verified: Verified that system properly activates defensive degraded mode upon memory pressure, feature corruption, or component failure.
checklist_descriptions.negative_security_tests_verified: Verified that all negative security tests (NT-1 through NT-5) pass without evasion or uncaught exceptions.
checklist_descriptions.cryptographic_checksums_verified: Verified that all model weights, datasets, manifests, and reports match their SHA-256 hashes.
checklist_descriptions.secrets_audit_zero_leaks_verified: Verified that zero passwords, API tokens, database URLs, or private keys are exposed in codebase or git logs.
checklist_descriptions.honest_reporting_not_executed_preserved: Verified that pending human reviews (KPI-2, AC-3) are explicitly reported as NOT_EXECUTED rather than falsely claimed as PASS.

status_contract.acceptance_condition: Both primary and secondary reviewers must record overall_determination = 'PASS', supply valid non-placeholder identities with signatures (>= 16 chars SHA256/hex), and verify all 12 checklist criteria as true.
